verify.note: wowsimcli on this request, 180 ± 20 s, 20,000 iterations, seed 1 (the request's own seed), 2026-11-03 (round 70753); not yet the DPS report's main run

summary: Marksmanship with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out). It's behind Marksmanship with a cat, even though Forever pets get no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, walk to 12 yd, Hunter's Mark at -1.5s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Hunter's Mark (rank 4, +143 ranged attack power) at -1.5s, recast in its last 3s. The raid's mark is off
Arcane Shot on cooldown, before Aimed Shot, at any mana
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot, at any mana
Serpent Sting when it's down, after Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana is at least 10 per second of fight left

Melee weave between Auto Shots. Walk in for a main-hand swing with Raptor Strike queued, when the next Auto Shot is 1.2s or less away and no shot comes off cooldown. Only while mana is at least 25 per second of fight left
Auto Shot the whole fight. No pet
caveats: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power, from the launch realms' hotfix of 2026-11-03 (ranks 20, 35, 50, 75 and 100). Hunter's Mark gives 143 after a server hotfix (older clients said 71).
Uses Aspect of the Hawk rank 6 (110 ranged attack power), from the launch realms' hotfix of 2026-11-03 (the client still says 55).
Arcane Shot gets 15% of ranged attack power, and Serpent Sting 5% a tick, from Blizzard's November 2 notes. No game data has them.
Auto Shot keeps firing during casts. Moving cancels its 0.5s wind-up.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't counted. They would add 17 DPS.
Rapid Killing never triggers on a single boss.
Crit per Agility is Classic's level 60 rate (0.0189% per point), from Forever's game files.
Uses a 2.5s bow with Rhok'delar's 44.0 weapon DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 DPS higher with a 15% ammo pouch, or 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era's 14% pouch.
Assumed: each hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark, and the raid's mark is off. That costs 0 to 2.9 DPS at 180s (2.7 here).
No Scorpid Sting. Balance druids already keep up Insect Swarm, which gives the same 2% hit reduction. Scorpid Sting would replace Serpent Sting and cost about 85 to 100 DPS for nothing.

Improved Tracking 5/5 counts against the generic boss, unlike creature-type talents such as Beast Slaying: a hunter can track every raid boss type except Mechanical. It is worth 62.6 DPS (4.8%) here, which this build loses against a Mechanical boss.
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_lw, the hunter_presets.sh rotation); it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Every hunter keeps up its own Hunter's Mark (standards 23, Mark duty assumed), so the raid's debuffs.huntersMark is off. Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone). Night Elf since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Windshaper Skyborne. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. No Goblin Sapper since 2026-11-02 (consumables-20261101-1): it reaches only 10 yd and the hunter stands at 12 or 25 yd, so it went off only when a weave happened to be under way at its cooldown, for 0.0 to 0.5 at 180 sec; the EZ-Thro Dark Bomb stays.
